registry.description: Hope is the inner orientation toward a future good that is not yet visible — the conviction that what God has promised will actually come. The Hebrew vocabulary covers expectation, waiting, confidence; the Greek elpis is the settled trust that something good is coming. Biblical hope is not wishful thinking but grounded expectation: it is based on the character and track record of God rather than on assessment of circumstances. It gives the inner person the capacity to endure the present without being crushed by it.
